11
Misraim mmakan rebɛwuwu
1Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Mɛma ɔhaw baako aba Farao ne Misraim so bio, na ɛno akyiri no, ɔbɛma moafiri ha akɔ koraa; pamo mpo na ɔbɛpamo mo afiri ha. 2#Eks 3.21-22 Afei kasa ma ɔman no nte sɛ: Mmarima ne mmaa mmisabisa wɔn nnamfonom hɔ dwetɛ nnwinneɛ ne sika nnwinneɛ. 3Na AWURADE maa ɔman no anim baa nyam wɔ Misraimfoɔ anim; nso ɔbarima Mose no yɛ kɛseɛ pa wɔ Misraim asase no so wɔ Farao nkoa ne ɔman no anim.
4Na Mose kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Anadwo dasuo mu no, mɛfiri adi mafa Misraim, 5#Eks 4.23 na Misraim asase so mmakan nyinaa bɛwuwu, ɛfiri Farao abakan a ɔtena n’adwa soɔ so de kɔsi afenaa a ɔwɔ oyuyammoɔ akyire abakan ne mmoa mmakan nyinaa so. 6Na osu kɛseɛ a ɛso bi mmaa da, na ɛso bi nso remma bio bɛba Misraim asase nyinaa so. 7#Eks 9.4, 26 Na Israel mma nyinaa deɛ, ɔkraman mpo rentwe ne tɛkyerɛma ntia wɔn, ɛfiri nnipa so kɔsi mmoa so, na moahunu sɛ AWURADE apae Misraim ne Israel ntam. 8Na wo nkoa yi nyinaa bɛsiane aba me nkyɛn abɛkoto me aka sɛ: Firi adi kɔ, wo ne ɔman a ɛdi w’akyire no nyinaa. Na ɛno akyiri no mɛfiri makɔ. Na ɔde abufuhyeɛ firii Farao nkyɛn kɔe. 9Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Farao rentie mo, na ama m’anwanwadeɛ adɔɔso wɔ Misraim asase so. 10#Eks 4.21 Na Mose ne Aaron yɛɛ anwanwadeɛ yi nyinaa wɔ Farao anim, na AWURADE pirim Farao akoma, na wamma Israelfoɔ no amfiri n’asase so ankɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Mɛma ɔhaw baako aba Farao ne Misraim so bio, na ɛno akyiri no, ɔbɛma moafiri ha akɔ koraa; pamo mpo na ɔbɛpamo mo afiri ha. Afei kasa ma ɔman no nte sɛ: Mmarima ne mmaa mmisabisa wɔn nnamfonom hɔ dwetɛ nnwinneɛ ne sika nnwinneɛ. Na AWURADE maa ɔman no anim baa nyam wɔ Misraimfoɔ anim; nso ɔbarima Mose no yɛ kɛseɛ pa wɔ Misraim asase no so wɔ Farao nkoa ne ɔman no anim.
Na Mose kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Anadwo dasuo mu no, mɛfiri adi mafa Misraim, na Misraim asase so mmakan nyinaa bɛwuwu, ɛfiri Farao abakan a ɔtena n’adwa soɔ so de kɔsi afenaa a ɔwɔ oyuyammoɔ akyire abakan ne mmoa mmakan nyinaa so. Na osu kɛseɛ a ɛso bi mmaa da, na ɛso bi nso remma bio bɛba Misraim asase nyinaa so. Na Israel mma nyinaa deɛ, ɔkraman mpo rentwe ne tɛkyerɛma ntia wɔn, ɛfiri nnipa so kɔsi mmoa so, na moahunu sɛ AWURADE apae Misraim ne Israel ntam. Na wo nkoa yi nyinaa bɛsiane aba me nkyɛn abɛkoto me aka sɛ: Firi adi kɔ, wo ne ɔman a ɛdi w’akyire no nyinaa. Na ɛno akyiri no mɛfiri makɔ. Na ɔde abufuhyeɛ firii Farao nkyɛn kɔe. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Farao rentie mo, na ama m’anwanwadeɛ adɔɔso wɔ Misraim asase so. Na Mose ne Aaron yɛɛ anwanwadeɛ yi nyinaa wɔ Farao anim, na AWURADE pirim Farao akoma, na wamma Israelfoɔ no amfiri n’asase so ankɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
